$comment: Deploy inputs wrangler.jsonc cannot hold, read by scripts/release/manifest-lib.ts (the release manifest, ADR 0160) and scripts/deploy.mjs. `features.ai`: Workers AI and Vectorize, remote-only so left out of wrangler.jsonc (ADR 0156); turned off with CRM_AI=off or `create-crm --ai off`. `vectorize`: how each index is created. `aiGateway`: the AI Gateway installs create with AI on (ADR 0180): its settings (authentication is always on) and the custom providers to create, called as custom-<slug>. `secrets`: optional secrets beyond package.json's. Values are never committed.

secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
secrets.description: Optional. Settings → AI's Cloudflare API token: provider keys as Workers secrets, AI Gateway usage (docs/deploying.md, In-app AI). Set from CRM_AI_ADMIN_TOKEN.

secrets.name: AI_GATEWAY_TOKEN
secrets.description: The AI Gateway token (an account token with AI Gateway Run), sent as cf-aig-authorization. Generated by the installer and the updater (ADR 0180).
